description: Reads one automation run and its step-by-step trace: under run, the run’s status, timings, what it sent and why it failed; under steps, each step it took with its status and error, one page at a time. Text inside a run can quote what a customer wrote, and comes back marked untrusted. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

name: get_run
title: Read an automation run
